atrLen = input(14, "ATR Length", 2, 60, 1)
coilLook = input(60, "Range Coil Lookback", 20, 120, 1)
vovLen = input(30, "VoV Lookback", 5, 60, 1)
compThresh = input(10, "Compression Threshold", 2, 40, 1)
expMult = input(1.5, "Expansion Multiplier", 1.1, 3.0, 0.1)
vovRise = input(3, "VoV Rise Bars", 2, 6, 1)
relTurn = input(2, "Release ATR Turn", 1, 5, 1)
markerSize = input(1.0, "Marker Size", 0.2, 3.0, 0.1)

tr = max(high - low, max(abs(high - close[1]), abs(low - close[1])))
coilAtr = atr(high, low, close, atrLen)
coilRange = high - low
vov = stdev(coilAtr, vovLen) / max(coilAtr, 0.0001)
trSd = stdev(tr, vovLen)
predRaw = 100 * (1 - trSd / max(coilAtr, 0.0001))
predRead = max(min(predRaw, 100), 0)
vovTrend = vov > vov[1] and vov[1] > vov[vovRise]
rngLow = lowest(coilRange, 10)
rngLowPrev = rngLow[1]
expansion = coilRange > expMult * max(rngLowPrev, 0.0001)
atrUp = coilAtr > coilAtr[relTurn]
armLevel = 100 - compThresh

cntA = 0.0
cntR = 0.0
for i = 1 to 60 {
  if coilAtr >= coilAtr[i] {
    cntA = cntA + 1
  }
  if coilRange >= coilRange[i] {
    cntR = cntR + 1
  }
}
loadATR = 100 * cntA / 60
loadRng = 100 * cntR / 60
coilLoad = 100 - (loadATR + loadRng) / 2

armed = coilLoad[1] > armLevel and vovTrend[1]
releaseTrig = armed and expansion and atrUp and not armed[1]
buySig = releaseTrig and close > open
sellSig = releaseTrig and close < open
coiled = coilLoad > armLevel and vovTrend

    }
    if low < sl[1] {

    } else {
